notes: Reaction-dynamics reconstruction for the accepted four_link and slider_crank local kinematic FullVA closed-loop solves. After Phi=0, Phi_q qdot=nu, and Phi_q qdd=gamma are solved, the run reconstructs multipliers from Phi_q^T lambda = [F-Ma; -(J alpha + omega x J omega)] and checks translational and rotational Newton-Euler residuals. This supplies the local dynamic/reaction rows for these driven closed-loop examples.
